integrity: The proof is analytical; standalone exact finite computations are corroborating tests and not a substitute for the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact claims apply only to odd-dimensional central Boolean Hamming balls and exactly one even-to-odd Walsh frequency replacement; older equivalent formulations using known Krawtchouk identities and Hadamard perturbations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp one-frequency Walsh-basis substitution on central Boolean Hamming balls
